No lengthy setup

Four steps, and everything is clear

EarnIt Kids remembers the agreement: what to do, how many coins it earns, and who approved it.

1

You create tasks and rewards

Specific wording means fewer questions later.

2

Your child sees only their list

Today’s tasks, available rewards, and their history.

3

Done sends you a request

Coins are not added until you confirm the result.

4

Rewards work the same way

Your child chooses, and you decide when it is suitable.

Why Telegram?

It is usually already open. Quick approvals do not require another app.

Requests arrive automatically.
Approval takes one tap.
Settings stay in the Mini App.
Tasks

Not “clean up properly”, but one clear task

“Read for 15 minutes” works better than “read more”. Tasks should be just as clear in the app.

Useful groups stay close

Frequently used groups appear first; rare ones stay in More.

History is visible

The last completion date sits next to the task.

Limits prevent farming

A daily maximum means one easy task cannot be repeated forever.

Start with three tasks

Add the things you already remind your child about most often.

For example

Morning start - 1 coin
Reading spark - 2 coins
Clear your desk - 1 coin
Rewards

Rewards you agree on in advance

It does not have to be a purchase. A film, board game, walk, or 20 minutes together can all be rewards.

You make the list

There is no built-in shop, only options you are ready to offer.

Your child sees what remains

If a reward needs 8 more coins, that is clear immediately.

Parents have the final say

Even when there are enough coins, you choose the right moment.

Try the full family workspace

Explore a temporary interactive workspace with tasks, coins, rewards, requests, family settings, and a child view — or sign in to open your own shop.

Try full live demoSign in to your own shop
For parents

You do not need to live inside the app

Everyday decisions arrive in Telegram. Open the Mini App when you need to change tasks, rewards, limits, or family settings.

Requests arrive automatically

See a completed task or reward request in Telegram and decide there.

Every child has their own space

Balances, tasks, rewards, and limits never get mixed.

Invite another parent

They can join by email or Telegram and use their own sign-in.

Settings stay separate

Limits, notifications, CSV import, and parent accounts do not crowd the home screen.

Daily or weekly coin limits.
A separate reward limit.
CSV task and reward import.
Separate parent and child notifications.
